# Runs 6 & 7 — sdh-spot-check, raw MR first (no background removal, no log)
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, current_channel, summarize_run

def spot_trace(rid):
    run = open_run(f'data/{rid}')
    print(summarize_run(run))
    chs = resolve_channels(run.meta)
    cur = current_channel(chs)
    v = [c for c in chs if not c.is_current and c.cid == 'sr1'][0]
    B = run.col('magnet_field')
    I = run.col(cur.col) / cur.gain
    R = (run.col(v.col) / v.gain) / I
    o = np.argsort(B)
    return B[o], np.abs(R[o]), np.abs(I[o]), run

fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))
for ax, (rid, lbl) in zip(axs, [(6, 'run 6: e-side n=+3.2e12, D=0, B 0->10 T'),
                                (7, 'run 7: h-side n=-1.2e12, D=0, B 10->0.3 T')]):
    B, R, I, _ = spot_trace(rid)
    ax.plot(B, R, lw=0.6)
    ax.set_xlabel('B (T)'); ax.set_ylabel('R_xx = (sr1/gain)/I_meas (Ohm)')
    ax.set_title(lbl, fontsize=10)
    print(f'run {rid}: R(low-B edge) = {np.median(R[B < B.min() + 0.2]):.0f} Ohm, R_max = {R.max():.0f} Ohm, '
          f'I_min = {I.min()*1e9:.2f} nA, |X|max/sens = {(R*I).max()/50e-6:.2f}')
fig.tight_layout()

# Runs 6 & 7 — onset tracking + FFT in 1/B vs F_L and the fs_count_b0 model
import sys
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, sdh_fft, luttinger_frequency, SdhOnsetError
sys.path.insert(0, '/home/hera/measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count')
import fs_count_b0 as fs

# FFT windows: run 6's fine (10 mT) leg starts at 1.0 T — the 50 mT leg below
# undersamples the 7 T tone below B ~ 0.85 T (d(1/B) Nyquist), so the FFT
# window starts at 1.0 T for both runs (also above run 7's 0.71 T onset).
CUT = 1.0
fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))
for ax, (rid, n12) in zip(axs, [(6, +3.2), (7, -1.2)]):
    B, R, I, _ = spot_trace(rid)          # from the raw cell above
    FL = luttinger_frequency(n12 * 1e16)  # h/4e * n  (m^-2)
    try:
        on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / np.median(I))
        print(f'-- run {rid} (F_L = {FL:.1f} T):')
        print(on.summary())
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print(f'-- run {rid}: SdhOnsetError: {e}')
    m = B >= CUT
    freqs, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(CUT, float(B.max())))
    sp = spec[0] / spec[0].max()
    ax.plot(freqs, sp, lw=0.8, label='FFT (1/B)')
    ax.axvline(FL, color='r', ls='--', label=f'F_L = {FL:.1f} T')
    for F, mm in fs.abab_mstar(n12 * 1e16):
        ax.axvline(F, color='g', ls=':', alpha=0.9)
    ax.plot([], [], 'g:', label='ABAB model F(n)')
    Ft, ma = fs.abca_mstar(n12 * 1e16)
    ax.axvline(Ft, color='m', ls='-.', alpha=0.8, label=f'ABCA {Ft:.1f} T (m*={ma:.2f})')
    dF = 1.0 / (1.0 / CUT - 1.0 / B.max())
    ax.set_xlim(0, FL * 1.7); ax.set_xlabel('F (T)'); ax.set_ylabel('FFT (norm)')
    ax.set_title(f'run {rid}: window [{CUT:.1f}, {B.max():.0f}] T, dF = {dF:.2f} T', fontsize=10)
    ax.legend(fontsize=8)
    pk = [float(freqs[k]) for k in range(1, len(sp) - 1)
          if sp[k] > 0.15 and sp[k] >= sp[k-1] and sp[k] >= sp[k+1] and freqs[k] > 3]
    print(f'run {rid}: FFT peaks >15% in window: {["%.1f" % f for f in pk]}')
fig.tight_layout()

**Read (runs 6 & 7, per investigation `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count` step 3).**

**Run 6 — electron, n = +3.2×10¹², F_L = 33.1 T.** Two strong candidates: **7.1 T** (SNR 41; *censored* — above threshold to the record's low edge, and the sub-1 T leg is 50 mT-coarse, undersampling a 7 T tone below B ≈ 0.85 T, so the true onset is unpinned below ~1 T) and **22.2 T** (SNR 101, onset 1.33 T). Against the model (`fs_count_b0`, semi-quantitative): ABAB pair at this n = {7.3, 25.8} T. Observed pair sums to 29.3 T = **0.885·F_L** — inside the lever-arm scale band (0.8–1.2); at that single global scale the model pair is {6.5, 22.8} vs observed {7.1, 22.2}. **Consistent-with ABAB — but not yet a call**: 22.2 T sits within one δF of 3×7.1 = 21.3 T (δF ≈ 1.5 T on the heavy tone's usable record), so heavy-pocket vs 3rd-harmonic is *unresolvable in a single column* — exactly the confound the recipe warns the ratio-screen eats (obs. ratio 3.13; model 3.53). The n-trajectory in the fan decides: a real heavy pocket follows its own Onsager curve, a harmonic tracks 3×f_light(n) exactly. Also present: a censored low-tone forest (3.0/4.2/5.2/9.5 T) — real extra Fermi surfaces would upend the 2-FS read, but these may be coarse-leg sampling aliases of the 7.1 T tone; needs a grid-change screen (`sdh-spot-check` Verify) on a fine uniform grid.

**Run 7 — hole, n = −1.2×10¹², F_L = 12.4 T.** The crowded near-CNP exception regime the investigation names (pair close and balanced): {4.7, 6.6} T sums to 11.3 T = **0.91·F_L** (scale consistent with the electron side), near the model ABAB hole pair {5.3, 7.1}; on top, a strong **12.3 T ≈ F_L** tone (SNR 124) — the F_L-tone-origin fork (breakdown/sum tone vs ABCA-domain singleton), *expected* for ABAB since inter-block breakdown is symmetry-allowed. ABCA at this n has m* ≈ 1.1 mₑ — LK-dead at this rig's T_e ≈ 8 K, so a hole-side singleton read is resolvability-limited here regardless. Gate limits cap the hole side at |n| ≤ 1.27×10¹² — deep inside the exception regime.

**Verdict: the electron side is the fan side** (templates separate at |n| ≳ 2–3×10¹²; hole side can't reach them). Two steps: (1) **low-field extension** at the electron spot, B 0.2 → 1.3 T on a fine uniform grid — pins the censored onset (fan B_lo lever, `landau-fan` step 1) and grid-change-screens the 3–5.4 T forest (~45 min); (2) **the Landau fan**, electron side, n ≈ 1.6 → 3.27×10¹² at D = 0, B_lo (from the extension) → 10 T, uniform-1/B rows — design landing in the measure notebook with the extension.

## HERA — SdH spot check, low-field extension (`sdh-spot-check`): electron spot, B 0.2 → 1.3 T fine-uniform

> **05:30** · sdh-spot-check low-B extension: electron spot n=+3.2e12 D=0; B 0.2->1.3 T uniform 2 mT (551 pts); sr1 50 uV, dwell 3 s; pins censored onset (fan B\_lo) + alias screen on 3-5.4 T tones · **ETA ~06:15** (≈45 min)

Runs 6/7 read (ana): electron side is the fan side — candidate ABAB pair {7.1, 22.2} T summing to 0.885·F_L, with the heavy-vs-3rd-harmonic fork open. Two things gate the fan design and both live below 1 T, where run 6's grid was 50 mT-coarse (undersamples the 7.1 T tone below B ≈ 0.85 T): **(1) the fan's B_lo** — the carrying tone is *censored* at run 6's usable low edge, and `landau-fan` step 1 requires the measured onset, with a cheap low-field extension when censored (B_lo sets the fan's row count: rows ∝ 1/B_lo, ~1.7 h per 0.2 T of unnecessary depth); **(2) the 3.0/4.2/5.2/9.5 T low-tone forest** — real extra pockets would change the FS count itself; a fine uniform grid is the `sdh-spot-check` Verify grid-change screen (aliases move, pockets stay). This cell: same spot as run 6 (n = +3.2×10¹², D = 0), B 0.2 → 1.3 T at 2 mT uniform (Nyquist-clean for 7.1 T down to ~0.17 T), sr1 50 µV, dwell = blocking set + 3 s settle = 10τ. Overlaps run 6's fine leg over 1.0–1.3 T for cross-checking. Ends at 1.3 T, gates at the spot — the fan rides down to its B_lo from there. Checkpoints: first ~20 rows (signal, leakage, sensitivity), then the onset read feeds the fan design directly.

# === SdH spot check, low-field extension (`sdh-spot-check`): electron spot n = +3.2e12, D = 0; B 0.2 -> 1.3 T, uniform 2 mT ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)  # run-5 calibration
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0  # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm — same spot as run 6
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: sweep starts at 0.2), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- field grid: uniform 2 mT, 0.2 -> 1.3 T (551 pts). Nyquist-clean for the 7.1 T
# tone down to B ~ 0.17 T and for the 3-5.4 T forest down to ~0.12 T; overlaps run 6's
# fine (10 mT) leg over 1.0-1.3 T for the grid-change cross-check.
B_vec = np.round(np.arange(0.2, 1.3001, 0.002), 4)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)  # inherit run 6 (R here ~50-70 Ohm; no clipping risk at low B)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, "
      f"tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"sdh-spot-check low-B extension, electron: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), "
                  f"(Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0.2 -> 1.3 T uniform 2 mT, sr1 50 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'low-B extension, electron side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; '
              f'(Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); B 0.2 -> 1.3 T uniform 2 mT; '
              f'pins run-6 censored onset (fan B_lo) + grid-change alias screen on the 3-5.4 T tones; cal run 5')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 1.3 T — the fan rides down to its B_lo from here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
